user.title: Choose the mower
user.description: Pick the lawn mower entity from the Dreame lawn mower integration.

mower.title: Mower entities
mower.description: These were looked up on the mower's own device; check them. The zone selector, the selected-zone height and the docked sensor are required. The calendar is the mower's schedule: without it nothing runs before a mow, but Check now and Apply now still work.

map.title: Mowing map
map.description: The map whose zones are managed. Zone heights are read and written on this map.

weather.title: Weather sources
weather.description: Open-Meteo is always used, for this location, and fills any gap. The other sources are optional: the forecast entity's max and min replace Open-Meteo's for today and ahead; a weather station's long-term statistics replace past temperatures and rain; a rain gauge's last 24 hours, a Smart Irrigation water balance and a warnings sensor (a heatwave warning raises the height) feed the plan directly.

error.no_zones: This selector lists no zones with a number such as "Lawn (#1)".

abort.already_configured: This mower is already set up.

init.title: Smart cut height
init.description: Thresholds, offsets, usual heights and the switches are entities on the integration's device. Here you change where the data comes from.

mower.title: Mower entities
mower.description: Saving also picks up zones added or renamed in the Dreame app.

weather.title: Weather sources
weather.description: Clear a field to stop using that source. Open-Meteo fills any gap.

error.no_zones: This selector lists no zones with a number such as "Lawn (#1)".

check.name: Check now
check.description: Plan from the weather, read the managed zones' heights and send any proposed change to the phone. Writes nothing.

config_entry_id.name: Mower
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one mower.

apply.name: Apply now
apply.description: Write the pending heights to the mower now, or once it is docked. Needs the Write to mower switch on.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Acknowledge that the mower's cut heights will change.

config_entry_id.name: Mower
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one mower.

skip.name: Skip 2 days
skip.description: Drop anything pending and make no change for 2 days.
